$schema.description: The JSON Schema of this file, for editors: a path relative to the file (e.g. ../schemas/release.schema.json, as 'stratarec schema --out schemas' writes them) or a URL. The engine ignores it: it is not part of the file's content id.

catalog.description: Catalog id; defaults to the pipeline id.

layer.description: The experiment's layer: a request is in at most one arm per layer, so the arms of one layer are never validated together and the arms of different layers are, unless one experiment yields to the other.

yields_to.description: Experiments of this release this one yields to: on a request also in an arm of one of them, this experiment runs in none of its arms (its layer runs the baseline, and the request records it as yielded), so the two never run together, as if they shared a layer. For two experiments of different layers that conflict or interact when putting them into one layer would cost too much traffic: this one gives up the other's share.
